notes: vals.ai is an Astro site and makes no XHR/fetch calls for leaderboard data: every benchmark page is server-rendered with its complete data payload embedded in the props attribute of an <astro-island> element. raw.json stores that payload per benchmark, keyed by URL slug, with Astro's [typeCode, value] prop wrapping undone. No value was altered.

Payload shape per benchmark: {default: {metadata, tasks}}, where tasks maps task key -> model id -> {accuracy, latency, stderr, cost_per_test, temperature, top_p, max_output_tokens, reasoning, reasoning_effort, verbosity, compute_effort, provider, harness}. normalized.json uses the 'overall' task only; all per-subtask breakdowns stay in raw.json.
cost_usd is the site's cost_per_test value (USD for a single test case), not a total run cost. latency_s is the site's latency value in seconds. Both are omitted when the site leaves them null.
rank is computed here by sorting the site's own overall accuracy values descending; it matches the ordering the site displays.
context_window is not published anywhere on vals.ai, so that field is absent from every record.

Models are identified by the provider-qualified id the payload uses (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5). Display names are resolved client-side from a JS bundle and are not in the payload, so ids are kept verbatim rather than guessed.

rsi_index is the one exception: a narrative report with five per-task result tables (3 models each) and no published overall score. Those tables were scraped from rendered HTML and appear in normalized.json with a 'task' field and metric 'index_score'; no aggregate was invented. Its date was reformatted from the page's 8/12/2026 to ISO.

Method: the browser (chrome-devtools MCP, isolated context 'vals-ai') was used to confirm no API exists and to locate the astro-island payload. The bulk fetch was then issued from Node with identical requests, because a co-resident agent kept stealing the shared browser's selected-page context mid-script. Fetched HTML byte lengths matched the browser fetch exactly.
